objective: Evolve MyBroker as a local daily personal analyst by absorbing only verified agentic workflow patterns.

summary.top_next_pattern: pattern freshness audit before adding new runtime authority

cases.observed_pattern: persistent workspace memory, staged tool use, messaging-style handoff
cases.mybroker_translation: keep daily artifacts, task state, review memory, and morning control as local files before any external effects
cases.why: This supports a daily operator loop without requiring a hosted web app or broad account authority.
cases.risk: over-automation if external-effect approvals are collapsed
cases.guardrail: prepare, approve, preflight, and execute remain separate gates

cases.observed_pattern: agent-native computer workspace with local memory and tool routing
cases.mybroker_translation: use narrow appliance commands and phone-readable surfaces instead of a generic unrestricted assistant
cases.why: Local workspace control is useful, but MyBroker needs finance-research boundaries and explicit non-execution defaults.
cases.risk: capability, identity, and knowledge poisoning if unchecked tools or untrusted memory shape decisions
cases.guardrail: validate artifacts, mark source freshness, and keep credentialed or live actions behind scoped approval

cases.observed_pattern: graph-style entity/event map, persona simulation, scenario paths
cases.mybroker_translation: market map, beginner explanations, persona viewpoints, and optimistic/base/downside paths
cases.why: The user wants a beginner-first way to understand market flows without having to provide a precise thesis.
cases.risk: simulation can feel authoritative when evidence is weak
cases.guardrail: show confidence, missing evidence, stale sources, and research-only action candidates

cases.observed_pattern: specialized analyst roles debate market, fundamentals, sentiment, and risk before a decision
cases.mybroker_translation: source scout, evidence curator, market mapper, scenario analyst, skeptic, tutor, memory librarian, publisher
cases.why: Role separation improves coverage and makes weak evidence visible to beginners.
cases.risk: role debate can drift into unsupported recommendations
cases.guardrail: roles produce questions, explanations, and research-only next inspections, not trade instructions

cases.observed_pattern: financial LLM agents grounded in reports, data, and analyst workflows
cases.mybroker_translation: ground generated briefs in local artifacts, source status, and archive history
cases.why: Grounding and auditability matter more than adding model complexity at this stage.
cases.risk: finance-specific agents may assume paid datasets, account context, or professional workflows
cases.guardrail: keep free/public/local evidence first and separate beginner education from execution

cases.observed_pattern: raw inbox, compiled wiki, linked notes, recurring audit
cases.mybroker_translation: compile local raw notes into reports/vault/wiki and feed scout, memory, today, and archive
cases.why: A personal analyst becomes useful when research compounds across days.
cases.risk: stale or biased notes can dominate later runs
cases.guardrail: surface source paths, freshness, and review feedback; do not delete raw notes automatically

cases.source: Claude Code finance research appliance workflow
cases.observed_pattern: plain-language research operator, local knowledge base, browser automation, scraper gateway, and four verbs: clip, compile, query, audit
cases.mybroker_translation: keep the phone as a command/review surface while the laptop loop records local memory, compiles vault notes, asks for short feedback, and proves whether feedback shaped the next scout
cases.why: The useful personal analyst pattern is not a hosted app first; it is a disciplined local research appliance whose memory compounds and whose operator handoffs are short.
cases.risk: browser/scraper access can quietly expand authority or pull weak sources into memory
cases.guardrail: live network, host writes, notifications, credentials, and paid/API operations stay behind scoped gates; copied feedback uses review-response-apply only

cases.observed_pattern: Claude Code plus local MCP gateway, Obsidian memory, task backlog, and cross-session context
cases.mybroker_translation: treat the local vault, task ledger, review log, and recall page as the first narrow gateway before adding broader tool access
cases.why: Personal agent systems are becoming useful through disciplined local memory and gateway boundaries, not through a generic always-on web app.
cases.risk: a broad gateway can turn stale memory or weak tasks into hidden authority
cases.guardrail: keep gateway-like commands narrow, artifact-backed, and separately validated before any external effect

cases.observed_pattern: autonomous research-agent loops with planning, source gathering, synthesis, and evaluation
cases.mybroker_translation: split daily work into agenda, scout, evidence, skeptic, tutor, memory, and publisher outputs with explicit quality checks
cases.why: A personal analyst needs repeatable research workflows and evals more than a chat-only interface.
cases.risk: autonomous synthesis can overstate confidence when sources are thin
cases.guardrail: show weak spots, source freshness, disagreement, and no-execution status in every user-facing research surface

cases.observed_pattern: local desktop research lab around multi-agent financial workflows and portfolio inspection
cases.mybroker_translation: favor a local appliance and phone-readable surfaces over a hosted dashboard, while keeping execution out of scope
cases.why: The useful part is local research ergonomics and role-specialized outputs; the risky part is drifting toward account-connected automation.
cases.risk: desktop lab metaphors can hide execution assumptions or professional-user assumptions
cases.guardrail: keep MyBroker beginner-first, research-only, and separate from account, order, or credential flows

cases.observed_pattern: code-first data analytics agent that turns requests into executable analysis steps
cases.mybroker_translation: later add sandboxed data-analysis notebooks for simulations and chart generation after artifact schemas are stable
cases.why: Code-first analytics could improve scenario simulation, but it should not precede memory quality, source quality, and clear user surfaces.
cases.risk: generated code can create nondeterministic or unverifiable conclusions
cases.guardrail: only run generated analysis in a sandbox with deterministic inputs, saved outputs, and validation

cases.observed_pattern: agent observability and traces for tool calls, decisions, and runtime behavior
cases.mybroker_translation: add run trace artifacts that explain which local steps shaped today's brief, recall result, and follow-up queue
cases.why: As the appliance becomes more autonomous, the operator needs traces to debug drift without reading every raw JSON file.
cases.risk: trace volume can become another unreadable log pile
cases.guardrail: summarize traces into a small daily proof, keep raw traces linkable, and validate freshness

cases.observed_pattern: persistent local agent loops keep heartbeat, latest-run, and duplicate-run state visible to the operator
cases.mybroker_translation: write a daily run ledger that identifies the canonical run for each local day, duplicate/manual runs, archive links, and no-external-effect proof
cases.why: A scheduled personal analyst must stay understandable when launchd, manual runs, and validation runs happen on the same day.
cases.risk: a ledger can become another unread log if it is not phone-readable
cases.guardrail: render a compact run-ledger surface and link it from morning/readiness/trace outputs

cases.source: Hosted trading bots and broker-connected agents
cases.observed_pattern: always-on execution, account credentials, live orders, discretionary automation
cases.why: This violates the current local research-only objective.
cases.risk: financial loss, compliance risk, and unsafe personalized execution
cases.guardrail: no brokerage credentials, no live trading, no discretionary management

cases.observed_pattern: self-hosted automated market agents connected to exchange credentials and live execution loops
cases.why: This is outside the current personal learning and research appliance boundary.
cases.risk: credential exposure, live execution loss, and unsupported personalized automation
cases.guardrail: no exchange credentials, no account connection, no live orders, no autonomous execution
